survey: Round wall clock seen straight on, hanging flat against a striped green wall. A thick, glossy orange ring frames a white dial and casts an even soft shadow on the wall, so the clock reads as resting against it. The dial has 12 navy hour bars, at 12, 3, 6, 9 and the eight positions between, plus a ring of small minute dots. Three hands share one central hub with a red cap: a short, thick navy hour hand, a longer navy minute hand and a thin red second hand with a short tail. The time reads about 10:10. The hour hand sits slightly past 10, which is the correct angle for that time, and the minute hand points at the 2. All hands turn on the same pivot and none passes through the rim. The ring is round and even all the way around.
